BiblicalUsage: Hod is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 7:37, the text says "and Hod." The life behind the name is told on the Hod People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hod matters because God knows His people by name, and Hod is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
